purpose: Teach: 晒さ/信奉/軒並み/制圧/編纂/標榜/帰化/枯渇

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員のプライバシーを晒される事のないよう注意しろ
lines.en: Make sure our company never exposes employee privacy.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Level tone, measured pace. A statement of expectation, not a question. Brief pause after the period.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。特定の経営思想を信奉しすぎないようにします
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we don't get too caught up in any single management philosophy.
lines.style: Respectful but grounded. Steady delivery, slightly slower pace showing thoughtfulness. Careful precision on each clause, as if noting it down mentally.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、競合店が軒並み撤退した地域に出店しろ
lines.en: Open stores in areas where our competitors have all pulled out.
lines.style: Direct and strategic. Crisp attack on the opening word. Even pacing, confident. The tone of someone issuing a calculated directive, not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。労使紛争を制圧ではなく対話で解決します
lines.en: Understood. We'll handle labor disputes through dialogue, not suppression.
lines.style: Professional acknowledgment. Slightly formal register. Each phrase articulated clearly, showing he's understood the distinction and is committing to it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社史を編纂する委員会を作れ
lines.en: Form a committee to compile our company history.
lines.style: Concise, matter-of-fact. A quick, final-sounding instruction. No extra breath—just the necessary words, delivered with finality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社会貢献を標榜する以上、実行を伴います
lines.en: Yes. Since we advocate for social contribution, we need to back it with action.
lines.style: Measured acknowledgment with underlying conviction. Slight emphasis on 'back it'—showing awareness of the moral weight. Calm but present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、外国人社員の帰化も支援しろ
lines.en: Support naturalization for foreign staff as well.
lines.style: Brief, inclusive directive. Steady tone. The word 'as well' carries weight—showing this isn't an afterthought but part of the same ethical framework.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。資源の枯渇に備えた代替素材も研究中です
lines.en: Understood. We're also researching alternative materials in case of resource shortages.
lines.style: Composed close. Calm, forward-thinking. Slight pause before 'also' to show this is a separate but related effort. Finality in the last clause.
